visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman with long dark hair wearing a beige wrap top and brown shorts standing in a restaurant interior. She is positioned in front of a vibrant red wall adorned with large golden Chinese characters and a sign that says 'VANJOAO HOTEL'. She smiles and gestures toward the branding with her right hand. (2) The camera transitions to a top-down view of a round table featuring a large, steaming Chongqing-style hotpot divided into sections. Numerous side dishes, including sliced raw beef, vegetables, and a bowl of fried rice with an egg, surround the bubbling red broth. (3) Hands appear using wooden chopsticks to manipulate the food. A slice of deep-red beef is dipped into a bowl of oily sauce mixed with green herbs. Another shot shows an egg yolk being mixed into a bowl of raw, tender beef slices. (4) The woman is shown again, this time in a series of photo-ready locations within the restaurant. She poses sitting on a red cushioned bench in front of vintage-style posters, and then stands on a decorated staircase with a man wearing a black cap. (5) Transitioning to the dessert section, the footage shows signs for 'Wen Dao Bing Shi'. Hands are seen using a metal spatula to scrape and serve 'milk tea' flavored shaved ice into a cup. A whole caramel pudding is carefully placed on top of a drink. (6) The video concludes with a creative edit showing five clones of the woman walking across a metal-walled area featuring the same posters. Finally, a yellow brand logo for 'Wen Jiu Ao' with two dragon illustrations appears on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo pop track featuring a male singer. The song has a strong, driving drum beat and bright electronic synthesizer layers. The mix is studio-clean with no audible environmental noise from the restaurant seen in the visuals. (2) A distinct 'whoosh' sound effect marks the first scene transition. The music continues with a steady 4/4 rhythm. The vocals are clear and melodic, while the percussive elements provide a high-energy pulse that drives the editing pace. (3) Another sharp 'hit' sound effect occurs as the scene changes to the food shots. The BGM remains the only significant audio source, with the background music volume staying consistent. There are no sounds of talking, clinking dishes, or ambient restaurant chatter. (4) Rapid-fire 'click' and 'whoosh' sound effects are synchronized with the fast-cut montage of the woman posing in different spots. The music's frequency response is bright and wide, with a dominant spectral weight in the mid-to-high ranges. (5) The track reaches a peak in energy as the dessert is shown. A final 'ding' sound effect accompanies the appearance of the brand logo at the end. The overall audio production is linear in its musical flow but fragmented in its SFX arrangement.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a newly opened Chongqing hotpot restaurant in Taichung called 'Wen Jiu Ao'. It highlights the authentic spicy hotpot dishes, the restaurant's aesthetic 'Instagrammable' photo spots, and its adjacent dessert shop, 'Wen Dao Bing Shi', to attract food enthusiasts and social media users.
